items.title: "We view AI as a sliding scale. There will always be a human in the loop; that's our ethos": Why Side has signed an MOU with Modl.ai to use AI for QA
items.excerpt: Side and Modl.ai signed an MOU at Gamescom to fold AI agents into game QA pipelines. The two companies discuss the role of AI in quality assurance, the tech's current limitations, and why human experts stay essential.

items.title: Three Epic veterans are building an AI-powered game engine to break the industry's doom cycle
items.excerpt: Three Epic Games veterans have launched Immens, an AI-powered game engine pitched at small teams. Amid mounting discontent with Unity and Unreal, Immens promises lower costs and faster development.

items.title: The Hollywood disruptors making a large-scale game with a 12-person team – and no generative AI
items.excerpt: The co-founders of Wolf Haus on how Hollywood heritage, cannabis millions, and in-house tech came together to build cult simulator Join Us — deliberately without generative AI in the pipeline.

items.title: Nvidia tech behind PUBG's genAI team mates will let folks chat to creature-collecting RPG Aniimo's not-Pokemon next year
items.excerpt: Nvidia ACE, the on-device character tech behind PUBG's genAI team mates, will let players talk to creatures in Pokemon-esque RPG Aniimo from early 2027.

items.title: "Hopefully a meteor will strike the earth soon": Game devs talk genAI witchhunts and the importance of honing your visual literacy
items.excerpt: Failbetter, New Blood and other game developers on the importance of honing your visual (and technical) literacy if you want to effectively spot — and fight — genAI art in games.

items.title: "Somebody will make the Half-Life 2 of AI" - after the Rideshare controversy, Saber CCO says something will come along and "change people's minds" about gen-AI
items.excerpt: All it will take to get people onside with gen-AI in games is one great game, Space Marine 2 company Saber believes. One "Half-Life 2 of AI".

items.title: No, the Humankind 2 announcement trailer wasn't made with gen-AI, despite it sharing a similar kind of look, developer Amplitude clarifies
items.excerpt: Amplitude had to publicly explain its Humankind 2 reveal trailer's art direction after players read its look as AI-generated — a sign of how style now reads as provenance.

items.title: How a Non-Programmer Used Aura to Build Dark and Darker's New Tutorial
items.excerpt: Dark and Darker developers IRONMACE explain how the AI coding agent Aura let a non-technical designer work directly with the game's codebase and prototype tutorial systems, cutting a 5-6 week feature to a couple of weeks.

items.title: How Tripo Is Tackling Clean Topology for its 3D Asset Pipeline
items.excerpt: Tripo Co-Founder Dr. Yanpei Cao discusses Smart Mesh, generating usable topology in seconds, giving artists more control over generated assets, and the shift from single-asset generation toward complete interactive worlds.

items.title: Interview: Building a Wuxia Sandbox RPG With Up to 10,000 Dynamic NPCs
items.excerpt: ConchShip Games explains how The Scroll of Taiwu drives up to 10,000 dynamic NPCs, 700+ martial arts skills and generational storytelling through systemic sandbox design rather than hand-authored content.

items.title: New Dev Tool From Meta Enables AI to Quickly Test Quest Games
items.excerpt: Meta introduced Meta XR Operator, an experimental tool that lets AI coding agents autonomously build, test, debug and visually verify VR apps — closing the loop that agents previously couldn't check.

items.title: Is This All You Can Conjure
items.excerpt: A withering look at Google's AI-in-games sales pitch: '...we are 3-4 years into this collective descent into madness, and this is all you can come up with to support it?'

items.title: After AI backlash, Assassin's Creed creator says 1666: Amsterdam "won't be using any AI anymore" and only used it "in conception and pre-production"
items.excerpt: Patrice Desilets says 1666: Amsterdam has dropped AI from production entirely after backlash, having used it only in concept and pre-production phases.

items.title: Here Are The Opening Night Live Games You Can Ignore Because Of GenAI Slop
items.excerpt: Kotaku catalogues the Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 reveals built on generative AI assets: 'Some were already known to feature genAI, but a lot of them are new.'

items.title: James Pond Co-Creator Calls AI-Rife Remake 'Soulless'
items.excerpt: Original developer Chris Sorrell condemns an AI-heavy James Pond remake as disrespectful and soulless: 'I hope they choke on an AI-generated fishbone.'

items.title: We're finally talking about AI, ft. David 'Rez' Graham and Luke Dicken
items.excerpt: Two veteran game-AI practitioners unpack AI and AI techniques in game development — a conversation about the nature of the work and where the real value sits.

items.title: Dwarf Fortress gets its first Myth and Magic update later this year, bringing each player's world its own procedural magic system
items.excerpt: Dwarf Fortress's long-promised Myth and Magic update will generate a bespoke magic system per world — procedural generation as authored design, not model output.
